text:
You're very welcome! I'm glad I could help you update the delivery address for your order. Your items will now be shipped to 456 Oak Street in Austin once your order is processed.

Have a great day, and thank you for contacting us!
zh:
不客气！我很高兴能帮您更新订单的送货地址。一旦您的订单处理完毕，您的物品将发往奥斯汀的456橡树街。

祝您今天愉快，谢谢您联系我们！
